title: ASAMYUKTA HASTA | single hand gestures (with meaning) | kaladarpan | bharatnatyam | classical dance

method.teacher_system: The teacher demonstrates each single hand gesture clearly one by one against a dark background, displaying the Sanskrit name and its English meaning on screen. Each mudra is held and presented cleanly without verbal instruction, allowing the learner to observe and copy the hand positions directly.

practices.what: Demonstrates the pataaka hasta gesture representing a flag.

moments.says: The teacher presents the title of single hand gestures in Bharatanatyam with clear text and traditional background music.
The teacher displays a thank you message to conclude the instructional video on hand gestures.

mentor.what_stays: The learner feels informed and equipped with the foundational knowledge of single hand gestures in Bharatanatyam.
